title: Hearty Fluffy Irish Custard Gratin
description: A comforting dessert featuring vanilla custard topped with a crunchy nutty streusel and baked in a traditional earthenware vessel.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware vessel to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the egg yolks, vanilla extract, and granulated sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy.
Add the milk to the egg yolk mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the custard mixture into the preheated vessel, filling it about 3/4 of the way full.
In a small bowl, combine the flour and softened butter to form a crumbly streusel topping.
Sprinkle the streusel topping evenly over the custard, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of the streusel with the chopped hazelnuts.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the streusel is golden brown and the custard is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional chopped hazelnuts if desired.
